name: Crowbar
pickupText: Deal bonus damage to enemies above 90% health.
description: Deal +75% (+75% per stack) damage to enemies above 90% health.

stacking.stat: Bonus damage vs. enemies above 90% health

name: Soldier's Syringe
pickupText: Increase attack speed.
description: Increases attack speed by 15% (+15% per stack).

name: Lens-Maker's Glasses
pickupText: Gain a chance to 'Critically Strike', dealing double damage.
description: Your attacks have a 10% (+10% per stack) chance to 'Critically Strike', dealing double damage.

stacking.cap: Reaches 100% (guaranteed crit) at 10 stacks; further stacks add nothing.

name: Tougher Times
pickupText: Chance to block incoming damage.
description: 15% (+15% per stack) chance to block incoming damage. Unaffected by luck.

stacking.formula: block chance = 0.15n / (0.15n + 1) — e.g. 13% at 1 stack, ~60% at 10 stacks, approaches but never reaches 100%

name: Tri-Tip Dagger
pickupText: Chance to bleed enemies on hit.
description: 10% (+10% per stack) chance to bleed an enemy for 240% base damage.

name: Paul's Goat Hoof
pickupText: Increase movement speed.
description: Increases movement speed by 14% (+14% per stack).

name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
pickupText: Deal extra damage to bosses.
description: Deal an additional 20% damage (+20% per stack) to bosses.

name: Backup Magazine
pickupText: Add an extra charge of your Secondary skill.
description: Add +1 (+1 per stack) charge of your Secondary skill.

name: Bison Steak
pickupText: Gain 25 max health.
description: Increases maximum health by 25 (+25 per stack).

name: Bustling Fungus
pickupText: Heal all nearby allies after standing still for 1 second.
description: After standing still for 1 second, create a zone that heals for 4.5% (+2.25% per stack) of your health every second to all allies within 3m (+1.5m per stack).

name: Cautious Slug
pickupText: Rapidly heal outside of danger.
description: Increases base health regeneration by +3 hp/s (+3 hp/s per stack) while outside of combat.

name: Monster Tooth
pickupText: Drop a healing orb on kill.
description: Killing an enemy spawns a healing orb that heals for 8 plus an additional 2% (+2% per stack) of maximum health.

stacking.stat: Heal per orb (% of max health)

name: Bundle of Fireworks
pickupText: Activating an interactable launches fireworks at nearby enemies.
description: Activating an interactable launches 8 (+4 per stack) fireworks that deal 300% base damage.

name: Delicate Watch
pickupText: Deal bonus damage. Breaks at low health.
description: Increase damage by 20% (+20% per stack). Taking damage to below 25% health breaks this item.

name: Energy Drink
pickupText: Increase sprint speed by +25%.
description: Sprint speed is improved by 25% (+25% per stack).

name: Focus Crystal
pickupText: Deal bonus damage to nearby enemies.
description: Increase damage to enemies within 13m by 20% (+20% per stack).

name: Gasoline
pickupText: Killing an enemy ignites other nearby enemies.
description: Killing an enemy ignites all enemies within 12m (+4m per stack) for 150% base damage. Additionally, enemies burn for 150% (+75% per stack) base damage.

name: Medkit
pickupText: Receive a delayed heal after taking damage.
description: 2 seconds after getting hurt, heal for 20 plus an additional 5% (+5% per stack) of maximum health.

name: Personal Shield Generator
pickupText: Gain a recharging shield.
description: Gain a shield equal to 8% (+8% per stack) of your maximum health. Recharges outside of danger.

name: Power Elixir
pickupText: Receive an instant heal at low health. Consumed on use.
description: Taking damage to below 25% health consumes this item, healing you for 75% of maximum health.

name: Repulsion Armor Plate
pickupText: Receive flat damage reduction from all attacks.
description: Reduce all incoming damage by 5 (+5 per stack). Cannot be reduced below 1.

name: Roll of Pennies
pickupText: Gain gold on taking damage.
description: Gain 3 (+3 per stack) gold on taking damage from an enemy. Scales over time.

name: Sticky Bomb
pickupText: Chance on hit to attach a bomb to enemies.
description: 5% (+5% per stack) chance on hit to attach a bomb to an enemy, detonating for 180% TOTAL damage.

stacking.stat: Chance on hit to attach a bomb

name: Topaz Brooch
pickupText: Gain a temporary barrier on kill.
description: Gain a temporary barrier on kill for 15 health (+15 per stack).

name: Stun Grenade
pickupText: Chance to stun on hit.
description: 5% (+5% per stack) chance on hit to stun enemies for 2 seconds.

name: Warbanner
pickupText: Drop a Warbanner on level up or starting the Teleporter event.
description: On level up or starting the Teleporter event, drop a banner that strengthens all allies within 16m (+8m per stack). Raise attack and movement speed by 30%.

name: Mocha
pickupText: Slightly increase attack speed and movement speed.
description: Increases attack speed by 7.5% (+7.5% per stack) and movement speed by 7% (+7% per stack).

name: Oddly-shaped Opal
pickupText: Reduce damage the first time you are hit.
description: Increase armor by 100 (+100 per stack) while out of danger.

name: Elusive Antlers
pickupText: Spawns orbs of energy that give bonus movement speed.
description: Spawns orbs of energy nearby every 10s (-10% per stack), giving +12% movement speed up to 3 (+3 per stack) times for 12s.

name: Chronic Expansion
pickupText: Deal bonus damage for each enemy killed.
description: Killing an enemy increases your damage by 3.5% (+1% per stack), up to 10 (+5 per stack), for 7s. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.

name: Warped Echo
pickupText: Incoming damage is reduced and dealt over time.
description: The next source of damage is reduced by 10% and spread into 3 (+1 per stack) hits. All echoed damage is non-lethal except for the final hit. Recharges every 15s.

name: Item Scrap, White
pickupText: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
description: A Common-rarity scrap with no effect. Consumed first by 3D Printers and Cauldrons, letting you preserve real items.

name: Rusted Key
pickupText: Gain access to a Rusty Lockbox that contains a powerful item.
description: A hidden cache containing an item (80% Uncommon / 20% Legendary) will appear in a random location on each stage.

stacking.formula: One lockbox per stage per key-holder; additional keys' effect on rarity vs. count needs logbook confirmation

name: Hiker's Boots
pickupText: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants critical strike chance and damage.
description: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants +1% (+1% per stack) critical strike chance and critical strike damage, up to 10 times. Lasts 10 seconds.

stacking.stat: Crit chance & crit damage per elevated hit (%)

name: Bolstering Lantern
pickupText: Increases your attack speed for every nearby enemy and ally.
description: Increase your attack speed by 10% (+3.5% per stack) for up to 3 (+1 per stack) enemies and allies within 20 meters.

name: Eclipse Lite
pickupText: Gain a small temporary barrier when a skill comes off cooldown.
description: When a skill comes off cooldown, gain a temporary barrier for 1% (+0.25% per stack) of your maximum health per second of the skill's base cooldown.

stacking.stat: Barrier per second of base cooldown (% max health)
